name: B018 and B023 SMS consent and Text-to-Join operator safeguards

scenarios.name: Manual consent requires an affirmative operator action

steps.text: an authorized roster manager opens an active group roster
the manager enters a contact without affirming consent
the Add person action remains unavailable

scenarios.name: Manual consent evidence is submitted with the roster mutation

steps.text: an authorized roster manager opens an active group roster
the manager affirms the approved statement and adds a contact
the request records the affirmation and optional consent method note

scenarios.name: Text-to-Join consent is visible without exposing message content

steps.text: an authorized operator opens a roster containing a Text-to-Join contact
Text-to-Join is identified as the consent source
no original inbound message body is displayed

scenarios.name: Missing consent remains visible to authorized operators

steps.text: an authorized operator opens a roster containing a contact without active group consent
the contact is labeled as having no active group consent

scenarios.name: Join advertising includes the required consumer disclosure

steps.text: an authorized operator opens an active group
the operator sees variable frequency charges STOP HELP and support disclosure guidance

scenarios.name: Archived join instructions are not advertised as active

steps.text: an administrator opens an archived group
the instruction is labeled inactive and roster changes are unavailable
